> ## ⚠️ 先说风险：上游正在收紧，随时可能用不了
>
> **2026-10-20 起，WorkBuddy 对话网关启用了针对第三方客户端的渠道校验**，本插件（以及所有同类第三方接入）都可能被直接拒绝。
>
> - 典型报错：`400 / code 11128 / Illegal API invocation from an unapproved channel`，中文提示「请求被拦截，请重新发送」「这次调用没通过渠道校验，可能不是官方客户端发出的」。
> - 校验维度在持续增加：已确认的有**系统提示词开头的固定句**（DSH 核心注入的 `You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness.`），以及**请求头格式**（`X-Conversation-*` 系列、`acp-connection-id`、`X-No-*` 的用法）。历史版本已经因为漏掉 `X-Conversation-*` 三件套、发错 `X-No-*` 而各被拦过一次。
> - **本插件是跟着官方客户端做字节级模仿**，属于猫鼠游戏：上游改一次，插件就可能失效一次，直到有人再适配。**没有任何版本能保证长期可用。**
> - **账号风险真实存在**：本轮排查中，一个 CN 账号的 refresh token 被上游吊销（`invalid_grant: User disabled`），另一个被判定「账号存在异常行为，已被限制使用」（`403 / 11140`）。频繁重试、批量轮换、异常调用节奏都可能加速这一判定。
> - 上游 [corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect) 已于 2026-10-20 **停止维护**，明确表示「尊重这一边界，不再继续适配」此类校验，仓库计划 2026-10-22 下线。本仓库是独立分支，仍在维护，但不代表这条路能一直走下去。
>
> **请自行评估是否值得用你的账号承担这个风险。** 介意的话，直接用官方 WorkBuddy 客户端。

---

这是 [corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect) 的维护分支，不是上游本体。上游 npm 包仍叫 `dsh-workbuddy-connect`（当前 `0.7.8`，锁 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`、pi-ai `1.3.0`）。本仓库发在 **`dsh-workbuddy-connect-next`**，界面和账号模型都走了另一条线。

国内版 **WorkBuddy** 与国际版 **WorkBuddy AI** 同时支持：装哪个 App 就出现哪个模型分组，两个都装就两组并存，各自用自己的账号与积分。

| | 上游 `dsh-workbuddy-connect` 0.7.8 | 本仓库 0.14.0 |
|---|---|---|
| 界面 | 设置里两张旧插件卡片 | 侧栏额度卡 + 中栏仪表盘 + 设置分区页（账号按产品合并成卡片，额度/用量/token/恢复时间都在名字下一行） |
| 账号 | 跟桌面 App 当前这一份登录 | 多账号池：轮换、扫码、令牌、桌面凭证；删除后不会被 30 秒扫描加回来；同一产品的账号合并在一张卡片里 |
| 额度 | 只在设置卡片上 | 侧栏一眼可见，可切「剩余 / 用量」样式，可关掉；设置页每账号显示剩余 / 已用 / 请求数 / token / 恢复时间 |
| DSH | **只** `0.2.0-rc.2` | **只** `0.2.1-rc.x`（peer `^0.2.1-rc.2`，见下方「支持的 DSH 版本」） |
| 更新提醒 | 右下角更新条 | 无（未移植） |
| npm | `dsh-workbuddy-connect` | `dsh-workbuddy-connect-next` |
两边都有：国内/国际分组、图片输入、推理档位检测、模型显隐、国内企业额度、选择器里的倍率与促销徽章、Windows Electron 发现、按区域识别 effort 拒绝码。

**请求身份**：chat 送出的是 `WorkBuddy/<v> WorkBuddy/<v> CLI/<v>` 的 UA（**两服都是 `WorkBuddy`，不带 `AI`**——两个官方包的网关代理都这么拼）、`X-IDE-*` 归属头、`X-Agent-Intent: craft` / `X-Agent-Purpose: conversation` / `X-Agent-Type: main` / `x-codebuddy-request: 1` / `X-Private-Data: true`，以及共享同一 traceId 的 `traceparent` + B3 + `X-Trace-ID`。会话头按官方规则分三层生命周期：`X-Conversation-ID` 一次会话稳定、`X-Conversation-Request-ID` 一轮稳定、`X-Conversation-Message-ID` 每请求新；空闲 30 分钟换会话、10 分钟换轮。chat 不带 `Origin`/`Referer`（官方原生客户端也不带），控制台接口仍然带。两服的 chat 头**完全相同**，只有 URL、`X-Domain` 和版本号按区域取；请求体差异也只有国际服补 system 消息、去掉 `reasoning_effort: off` 两条。
对话里直接用 WorkBuddy 模型（输入框显示倍率与推理档位，底栏有用量和额度）： 模型选择器按 WorkBuddy / WorkBuddy AI 分组，带倍率与免费标记： 设置页管账号池、周期额度与模型列表： 勾选要出现在选择器里的模型：

- **开箱即用**：装上并启用后，对话里直接选 WorkBuddy 模型。插件复用桌面 App 的登录，账号切换会跟。
- **仪表盘**：侧栏底部一张额度卡，点开中栏看完整面板；设置 → **DSH-WorkBuddy** 管账号、模型、上下文长度和推理档位检测。卡片本身可以关掉。
- **多账号轮换**：同一产品可放多个账号。请求在可用账号之间轮换；被上游限流的会暂时搁置，稍后自动重试。添加方式：扫码、网页令牌、桌面端凭证。
- **额度**：侧栏可显示剩余额度或「已用 / 总量」；国内企业账号走企业计费接口。
- **图片输入**：多数模型支持粘贴或拖入图片。
- **推理档位**：上游声明了的直接显示。没声明的，Web / Desktop 可在选择器里点「推理等级」手动检测（会发少量请求，可能扣积分）。
- **模型显隐**：按登录账号分别保存。隐藏只影响选择器，已有会话不受影响。

前置：已安装并登录 WorkBuddy 桌面 App（国际版同理）。核心必须对上，否则 DSH 起不来。

> **⚠️ 此次更新跨度较大，并未经过充分测试，更新后可能出现显示问题以及其他更严重的问题。**
> 升级前建议备份 `~/.dsh`（尤其 `.workbuddy-*.json` 状态文件与 `profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`）。
>
> 本版另有两处**不兼容变化**：entry id 改为 `llm-workbuddy-next`；locale 命名空间改为
> `settings.workbuddy.next` / `panel.workbuddy.next`。与上游 `dsh-workbuddy-connect` 同时安装会
> 因 provider id 冲突导致发消息失败，请只保留一个。

readme.section: 支持的 DSH 版本（**只此一条线**）
readme.text:
| 版本 | 是否支持 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `0.2.1-rc.x`（实测 `0.2.1-rc.2`） | ✅ **支持** | 本版按这条线的 kernel 与 `pi-ai 1.1.0` 编译并实测；peer range 为 `^0.2.1-rc.2`，同线的后续 rc 与 `0.2.1` 正式版都装得上 |
| `0.2.0-rc.x` | ❌ 不支持 | 其 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 基于 `pi-ai ^0.87.1`，与本版锁定的 `1.1.0` 冲突，进程里会同时存在两代 pi-ai，**请求在发出 HTTP 之前就报 `PI_AI_ERROR`** |
| `0.1.7-alpha.x` | ❌ 不支持 | 同上，那一线基于 `pi-ai ^0.85.1` |

`peerDependencies` 已收窄到 `^0.2.1-rc.2` 与 `@earendil-works/pi-ai ^1.1.0`，所以在装错的宿主上**包管理器会直接拒绝安装**，而不是装完才发现模型不能用。

readme.section: 支持的 DSH 版本（**只此一条线**）
readme.text:
> **⚠️ 如果你本机装的是上游 `dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.7.4`，在 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 上它是坏的。**
> 那个版本把 `pi-ai` 钉死在 `0.87.1`（`0.2.0-rc.2` 那一代），与当前内核的 `pi-ai ^1.1.0` 属于**两代不同的消息结构**，
> 表现是选中模型后一发消息就报 `PI_AI_ERROR`。要留在当前内核上，就得换成本包（上游 `0.7.8` 已经把 pi-ai 换成 `1.3.0`，
> 那一版本身是能用的，本包在它之上多的是界面、多账号与额度）。

守卫从「版本号必须等于 `1.1.0`」放宽为「**代际必须是 1.x**」：同一代际内部的补丁差异（`1.1.5`、`1.4.0` 等）与宿主的消息结构一致，
不再误报；`0.8x` 这一代仍然会被点名。宿主日后自带更新的 pi-ai 时，这条警告不会变成噪音。

**本版 `0.14.0` 只支持 DSH `0.2.1-rc.x`**（实测 `0.2.1-rc.2`）。**不要装在 `0.1.7-alpha.x` 或 `0.2.0-rc.x` 上** —— 原因见下。

> **不要装 npm 上的 `dsh-workbuddy-connect`。** 那是上游包，和本仓库不是同一条线。

DSH 的 **添加插件** 对话框接受：npm 包名（可带版本）、Git 地址、tarball、或本机绝对路径。

1. 打开 **设置 → 插件**（有的客户端写「扩展管理」）。
2. 选 **添加插件**。
3. 填下面任一标识，确认：

```text
dsh-workbuddy-connect-next
```

或：

```text
github:yoyo636/dsh-workbuddy-connect-next
```

4. 装完**刷新页面**；没生效就**重启 DSH 客户端**。桌面 App 由它自己拉起 profile，不要用 `dsh --profile desktop` 当启动命令。

把 `<profile>` 换成实际 profile（`web` / `desktop`）。

从 npm（推荐）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-workbuddy-connect-next
```

从 GitHub（仓库里已有预构建 `lib/`，git 安装不会跑 `prepack`）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:yoyo636/dsh-workbuddy-connect-next
```

```sh

dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-workbuddy-connect-next
dsh web
```

```sh

readme.section: Desktop（DSH 0.2+ 才让 CLI 管 desktop profile）
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-workbuddy-connect-next
```

DSH 0.2 之前 CLI 不接受 `desktop` profile，请走上面的界面安装。套壳桌面 App（如 DSH NEXT）的 CLI 入口是自带的 `desktop-cli`，它要求 PATH 上有 `pnpm`。

配置入口：text
设置 → 模型                         ← 不显示 WorkBuddy 两行（有意如此）
设置 → 内置插件 → workbuddy-connect  ← 只读运行状态，不是配置入口
侧栏底部                             ← 额度卡，点开中栏仪表盘
设置 → DSH-WorkBuddy                 ← 账号、模型、侧栏显示
聊天模型选择器                       ← WorkBuddy / WorkBuddy AI 分组
```

CLI 二进制仍叫 `dsh-workbuddy-connect`（和 provider id 一样没改，避免已装用户的脚本对不上）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> exec dsh-workbuddy-connect status
dsh plugin --profile <profile> exec dsh-workbuddy-connect accounts
dsh plugin --profile <profile> exec dsh-workbuddy-connect doctor
```

默认国内版；加 `--provider workbuddy-ai` 走国际版。`accounts` 只读。`logout` 只删插件自留副本，不动桌面 App 的登录。

- 在 macOS 的 Web / Desktop 下验证过（DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`，Node 22+）。Windows 依次探 Local 与 Roaming AppData；WSL 优先读挂载的 Windows 用户目录。用户名不一致时用 `WORKBUDDY_AUTH_FILE` / `WORKBUDDY_AI_AUTH_FILE`。
- 侧栏两个显示偏好要宿主能写设置；状态文档没有对应字段时，设置页不画开关。
- 国际版模型目录来自 App 界面接口，属私有实现，可能失效；届时按「本账号上次成功目录 → 内置目录」降级。
- 国际版企业计费未验证；无凭据时该版模型分组不再显示。
- 依赖 WorkBuddy 客户端接口，App 更新后插件可能要跟。
- **网关的渠道校验是最容易失效的一环**：它按「请求是否像官方客户端」判定，判定维度在增加（系统提示词开头、`X-Conversation-*` 三件套、`acp-connection-id`、`X-No-*` 的用法）。上游改一次，插件就可能整体不可用，直到有人再适配。
- 本插件当前按官方客户端的字节级特征做对齐，**不做任何风控规避**（不改 IP、不伪造设备指纹、不做批量注册）。因此上游若引入新的维度（设备、频率、签名），本插件不会尝试绕过。

仅供个人学习研究，只驱动使用者自己的账号在本机调用。遵守 WorkBuddy 服务条款；后果自负。与腾讯、WorkBuddy、DeepSeek 均无关联。

**关于封禁与稳定性的明确说明**（不重复上方风险框，只补可操作的部分）：

- 本插件通过模仿官方客户端的请求特征来通过网关校验。这类校验属于**对方单方面随时可变**的机制，本仓库无法承诺任何可用性期限，也不保证你的账号不会因此被限制或封禁。
- 上游自 2026-10-20 起收紧后，社区里已出现账号被限制的实例（含本仓库排查过程中的两个）。**建议只用自己的账号、控制调用频率、不要用于批量或多开场景。**
- 如果出现 `400 / 11128`，先确认是不是上游又换了校验维度，而不是急着反复重试 —— 重试本身可能加速风控判定。把 `requestId` 附在 issue 里比反复试更有用。
- 不提供任何规避风控、批量注册、多账号池规模化使用的支持。

---

The maintained successor of [corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect), not the upstream project. The upstream npm package is still `dsh-workbuddy-connect` (currently `0.7.8`, DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` only). This repository publishes as **`dsh-workbuddy-connect-next`**, with a different UI and account model.

Both the CN **WorkBuddy** app and the international **WorkBuddy AI** app are supported: whichever you have installed shows up as its own model group; both installed shows both, each with its own account and credit.
Compared with upstream **0.7.8** (2026-10-17). Features both trees share are not listed as ours.

| | Upstream `dsh-workbuddy-connect` 0.7.8 | This tree 0.14.0 |
|---|---|---|
| UI | two legacy plugin cards in Settings | sidebar credit card + centre dashboard + settings section page (accounts merged into one card per product; balance / used / tokens / reset sit on the line under each name) |
| Accounts | follows the desktop app's current sign-in | multi-account pool: rotation, QR, token, desktop adopt; a removed account is not swept back in; one card per product instead of one card per account |
| Credit | on the settings card only | in the sidebar, remaining or used/total, can be hidden; each account row also states used, requests, tokens and when the allowance returns |
| DSH | **`0.2.0-rc.2` only** | **`0.2.1-rc.x` only** (see “Supported DSH versions” below) |
| Update notice | bottom-right reminder | not ported |
| npm | `dsh-workbuddy-connect` | `dsh-workbuddy-connect-next` |

Both trees have: CN/AI groups, image input, reasoning-effort detection, per-account model visibility, CN enterprise credit, picker rate/promo badges, Windows Electron discovery, per-region effort-rejection codes.

**Request identity**: chat sends `WorkBuddy/<v> WorkBuddy/<v> CLI/<v>` as the UA (**`WorkBuddy` twice in both regions, never `AI`** — both shipped apps' gateway proxies compose it that way), the `X-IDE-*` attribution family, `X-Agent-Intent: craft` / `X-Agent-Purpose: conversation` / `X-Agent-Type: main` / `x-codebuddy-request: 1` / `X-Private-Data: true`, and `traceparent` + B3 + `X-Trace-ID` sharing one trace id. The conversation headers follow the official three-tier lifetime: `X-Conversation-ID` stable per conversation, `X-Conversation-Request-ID` stable per turn, `X-Conversation-Message-ID` fresh per request — a new conversation after 30 idle minutes, a new turn after 10. Chat sends no `Origin`/`Referer` (neither does the native client); the console endpoints still do. The two regions' chat headers are **identical**; only the URL, `X-Domain`, and the version are region-scoped, and the only body differences are the international system-message prepend and the removal of `reasoning_effort: off`.

WorkBuddy models in chat (rate and reasoning level in the composer, usage and credit on the status bar): Picker groups WorkBuddy / WorkBuddy AI, with rates and free badges: Settings page for the account pool, cycle credit and the model list:
Choose which models appear in the picker:

- **Zero configuration**: after install, pick a WorkBuddy model in chat. The plugin reuses the desktop app's sign-in and follows account switches.
- **Dashboard**: a credit card at the sidebar foot opens the centre-column panel; Settings → **DSH-WorkBuddy** manages accounts, models, context length and reasoning-level detection. The card itself can be switched off.
- **Multi-account rotation**: several accounts per product. Requests rotate across available ones; a rate-limited account is benched and retried later. Add via QR, a pasted token, or the desktop app's own sign-in.
- **Credit**: sidebar can show remaining credit or used/total; CN enterprise accounts use the enterprise billing endpoint.
- **Images**: most models accept paste or drag-and-drop.
- **Reasoning levels**: declared sets show up directly. Undeclared models can be probed from the picker on Web / Desktop (a few requests, may spend credit).
- **Visibility**: saved per signed-in account. Hiding a model only affects the picker; existing chats keep working.
Prerequisite: the WorkBuddy desktop app is installed and signed in (same for WorkBuddy AI). A mismatched DSH core fails to start.

> **⚠️ This release spans a large amount of change and has NOT been fully tested.** Display problems,
> and possibly more serious issues, may appear after upgrading. Back up `~/.dsh` before upgrading
> (especially the `.workbuddy-*.json` stores and `profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`).
>
> Two **breaking changes** ship with it: the Loader entry id is now `llm-workbuddy-next`, and the
> locale namespaces are `settings.workbuddy.next` / `panel.workbuddy.next`. Installing alongside
> upstream `dsh-workbuddy-connect` fails to send messages because both claim provider id `workbuddy`;
> keep only one of the two.

| Version | Supported | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `0.2.1-rc.x` (verified on `0.2.1-rc.2`) | ✅ **yes** | this build is compiled and tested against that kernel and `pi-ai 1.1.0`; the peer range is `^0.2.1-rc.2`, so later rcs of the same line and the `0.2.1` release install cleanly |
| `0.2.0-rc.x` | ❌ no | its `dsh-llm-pi-ai` targets `pi-ai ^0.87.1`; two generations in one process make **every request fail with `PI_AI_ERROR` before any HTTP** |
| `0.1.7-alpha.x` | ❌ no | same conflict; that line targets `pi-ai ^0.85.1` |

`peerDependencies` are narrowed to `^0.2.1-rc.2` and `@earendil-works/pi-ai ^1.1.0`, so a wrong host makes the **package manager refuse the install** instead of leaving you with a plugin whose models cannot answer.

> **⚠️ If your machine has upstream `dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.7.4`, it is broken on DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`.**
> That release pins `pi-ai` to `0.87.1` (the `0.2.0-rc.2` generation), which is a **different message shape** from the current kernel's
> `pi-ai ^1.1.0`. The symptom is a `PI_AI_ERROR` on the first message after picking a model. Staying on the current kernel means moving to this package
> (upstream `0.7.8` moved to pi-ai `1.3.0` and is usable itself; what this package adds on top is the dashboard, the account pool and the credit figures).

The guard now asks for the **1.x generation** instead of the exact version `1.1.0`: patch differences inside one generation (`1.1.5`, `1.4.0`, …) agree with the host about message shapes and no longer raise a false alarm, while the `0.8x` generation is still named. A host that later ships a newer pi-ai will not turn this warning into noise.

**This release (`0.14.0`) supports DSH `0.2.1-rc.x` ONLY** (verified on `0.2.1-rc.2`). **Do not install it on `0.1.7-alpha.x` or `0.2.0-rc.x`** — see below.
> **Do not install npm's `dsh-workbuddy-connect`.** That is the upstream package, a different code line.

DSH **Add plugin** accepts a package name (optional version), a Git address, a tarball, or an absolute local path.

1. Open **Settings → Plugins** (some clients label this Extensions).
2. Choose **Add plugin**.
3. Paste either identifier and confirm:

```text
dsh-workbuddy-connect-next
```

or:

```text
github:yoyo636/dsh-workbuddy-connect-next
```
4. **Reload the page**; if nothing changed, **restart the DSH client**. The desktop app starts its own profile — do not use `dsh --profile desktop` as a launcher.

Replace `<profile>` with the profile you use (`web` / `desktop`).

From npm (recommended):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-workbuddy-connect-next
```

From GitHub (the repo ships prebuilt `lib/`; git installs do not run `prepack`):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:yoyo636/dsh-workbuddy-connect-next
```

dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-workbuddy-connect-next
dsh web

One upstream change can make the whole plugin unusable until someone adapts again.

For personal learning and research only, driving your own account on your own machine. Comply with WorkBuddy's terms. Not affiliated with Tencent, WorkBuddy, or DeepSeek.

**On bans and stability** (the actionable part; the warning box above covers the rest):

- The plugin passes gateway checks by imitating the official client's request characteristics. Those checks are **theirs to change at any time**, so this repository promises no period of availability and does not guarantee your account will not be restricted or banned.
- Since the upstream tightened on 2026-10-20 there have been real cases of restricted accounts, including two during this repository's own diagnosis. **Use your own account, keep request rates sane, and do not use it for bulk or multi-instance workloads.**
- On a `400 / 11128`, first check whether the upstream changed the check rather than retrying in a loop — retrying can itself accelerate a risk-control decision. A `requestId` in an issue is worth more than repeated attempts.
- No support is offered for evading risk controls, bulk registration, or running large account pools at scale.
